mapper.select: select sp.* from seckill_product sp left join seckill_activity sa on sa.id = sp.activity_id where TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,NOW(),sa.start_time) < #{time}
select sp.* from seckill_product sp left join seckill_activity sa on sp.activity_id = sa.id where sa.status = 1

select sp.id, sp.sku_id, sp.seckill_price,sp.seckill_stock,sp.limit_per_user, p.name as productName, ps.specs as skuSpecs,ps.image, ps.price as originalPrice,ps.stock as skuStock from seckill_product sp left join product_sku ps on sp.sku_id = ps.id left join product p on ps.product_id = p.id where sp.activity_id = #{activityId}
